prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is entitled to compensation under the applicable policy.

Please direct all future communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a declaration page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also demand that your insured, your company, and its agents preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair estimates, witness statements, claim file materials, and any recorded communications. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
